_note: Milestone K companionship. Lines are templates filled ONLY from the speaker's own memory ({hint} = her own clue text, {creature} = something she fought, {book} = a book she read, {place} = a place she looked at, {other} = the other mage). The listener learns what she was TOLD (told:<speaker>:<topic>), never the fact itself. An optional language model may rephrase on camera (one call per conversation). Keep lines short: this is a livestream.

join._note: Who accepts an invitation: utility from her own state. strenuous = needs vigor.

stargaze_together.label: lie in the grass at {place} and watch the stars

share_creature: I ran into a {creature} earlier. It nearly got me.
There was a {creature} out past the circle. I handled it, mostly.
share_book: I finished reading {book}. My head is still spinning.
Have you read {book}? I just did.
share_place: I went to look at {place}. It felt like it was waiting for someone.
ask_creature: You fought a {creature}? What was it like?
Is it true you took on a {creature}?
ask_clue: You said something about {topic}. What did you mean?
ask_place: What did you find out there?
answer_creature: It was a {creature}. It telegraphs before it strikes, so watch for that.
A {creature}. I kept my distance and it worked.
answer_place: I went to {place}. You should see it.
answer_none: Honestly, nothing much. I mostly studied.
Not a lot to tell yet.
react_known: Me too! I noticed the same thing.
I know, right? I found that too.
react_creature_known: I've fought one too. They're tough.
Same here. Mine was faster than I expected.
react_creature_new: I haven't met one yet. I'll be careful.
I hope I never meet one alone.
reminisce: That time we {memory}... I still think about it.
reminisce_reply: I remember. That was a good day.
accept: Yes, I was hoping you'd ask.
decline_tired: I'm worn out. Maybe a little later?
I need to catch my breath first.
decline_busy: I'm in the middle of something. Later?
Give me a moment, I want to finish this.
together_arrive: Here we are. What do you think?
together_done: That was nice. Thanks for coming.
We should do this more often.
duel_reply: Go easy on me. Or don't.
duel_won: I got you! Did you see that?
Ha! That last one was close.
duel_lost: Okay, okay. You win this round.
duel_draw: Neither of us gave an inch.
stargaze_arrive: Here. Lie down, the grass is dry.
This is the spot. Come on, lie back.
stargaze_quiet: Listen. Even the woods go quiet for this.
I could stay like this a while.
stargaze_wonder: That bright one over the ridge never moves. The others wheel around it.
Do you think the old mages lay here too, before the ruins were ruins?
If a gateway opened up there, where would it go?
stargaze_reply: Maybe. I'd like to think so.
I don't know. I want to find out.
Mm. Ask me again when I'm not this comfortable.
stargaze_done: Okay. Up, before I fall asleep here.
We should head back. Thank you for this.
share_worry: That {creature}... I had to back off. I hate that I had to back off.
I ran from a {creature} today. Not my proudest moment.
There's a {creature} I couldn't handle. Yet.
react_worry: Then we get ready for it. Together, if you want.
You came back in one piece. That's what counts.
Next time you'll know how it moves.
share_triumph: Remember that {creature}? I beat it. I actually beat it!
I went back for the {creature}. This time I was ready.
The {creature} - it's done. I practised, and it worked.
react_triumph: See? I told you you'd get it!
That's amazing. Show me how you did it?
You were ready this time. It showed.

share_creature: A {creature} came at me. It regretted it.
share_book: I read {book}. Some of it was even useful.
ask_creature: You fought a {creature}? How did it go?
answer_creature: A {creature}. It is slow to recover after a big strike. That's the moment.
A {creature}. Don't stand where it marks the ground.
react_creature_known: I've met one. They're no joke.
Same. I learned to keep moving.
react_creature_new: Then I'll be ready for it.
accept: Fine. I was getting restless anyway.
together_done: Good. We should do this again.
duel_won: You're improving. Not enough, but improving.
duel_lost: You got me. I'll remember that.
stargaze_arrive: Fine. But if something crawls on me, we leave.
stargaze_wonder: The low star by the trees is red tonight. It wasn't, last week.
People used to steer by these. I'd trust them more than a map.
Somewhere up there is a place no one has named.
share_worry: A {creature} drove me off. I don't intend to let that stand.
I withdrew from a {creature}. I need to be better before I face it again.
There's a {creature} out there that was stronger than me. For now.
react_worry: Withdrawing was the right call. Now you prepare.
Tell me how it moved. We'll work it out.
Then practise your ward. That's where it got you, wasn't it?
share_triumph: The {creature} that drove me off. I went back. It's finished.
I faced the {creature} again. I was ready this time.
That {creature} - I beat it. Preparation is everything.
react_triumph: I knew you would. You never let things go.
Then it was worth the practice.
